bio: I'm a final-year Computer Science student specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, passionate about building intelligent systems that solve real-world problems. From production-ready NLP applications and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines to predictive machine learning models and full-stack web applications, I enjoy developing scalable, practical, and impactful solutions.

My expertise includes Python, machine learning, deep learning, REST API development, and modern AI frameworks. I've built end-to-end AI solutions, designed ML pipelines, and developed full-stack applications while continuously exploring the latest advancements in generative AI and large language models.

projects.title: YouTube RAG Question-Answering System
projects.description: A production-ready RAG backend that answers natural language queries from YouTube video transcripts.
points: Designed RAG backend answering natural language questions from transcripts with sub-15s end-to-end latency.
Implemented hybrid retrieval pipeline (FAISS dense + BM25 sparse) fused via RRF, cross-encoder reranker, and MMR diversity selection.
Achieved Context Precision@K of 1.00 and MRR of 1.00 across evaluation samples.
Exposed REST API via FastAPI with interactive Swagger UI and evaluated across 14 metrics.

projects.title: Enhanced Sign Language Recognition System
projects.description: Real-time sign language gesture recognition system with text-to-speech output for accessibility.
points: Built a real-time hand gesture recognition pipeline using MediaPipe for landmark detection and TensorFlow for classification.
Integrated text-to-speech (TTS) engine to vocalize recognized signs, enabling communication for hearing-impaired users.
Trained custom gesture classification model on ASL alphabet dataset achieving high accuracy across 26 classes.
Designed an intuitive interface for live webcam-based sign detection with real-time feedback.

projects.title: Secure Cloud Storage
projects.description: A secure cloud storage application with encrypted file management and Google Drive integration.
points: Developed a full-stack cloud storage platform with FastAPI backend and React frontend for secure file management.
Integrated Google Drive API for cloud storage operations with real-time file upload/download status tracking.
Implemented user authentication and authorization with encrypted file storage for data security.
Built responsive dashboard UI with file previews, folder management, and storage analytics.

projects.title: Lane & Vehicle Detection System
projects.description: Computer vision system for real-time lane marking and vehicle detection in driving footage.
points: Built a real-time lane detection pipeline using Canny edge detection, Hough line transforms, and region-of-interest masking.
Implemented vehicle detection using Haar cascades and contour analysis for multi-object tracking.
Processed video streams with frame-by-frame lane overlay and bounding box annotations.
Optimized pipeline for real-time performance using NumPy vectorized operations and OpenCV optimizations.

projects.title: Loan Approval Prediction System
projects.description: A containerized machine learning application predicting loan approval rates using applicant parameters.
points: Built ML web application predicting loan approval status based on applicant features.
Trained classification model using scikit-learn; containerized with Docker and deployed via Flask.
Designed end-to-end UI/UX for data input and model evaluation using confusion matrix analysis.
